subject: Treasury Insights: new features in Treasury Online
text:
Treasury Insights | Q4 2026

What's new in Treasury Online
- Account Validation: before you add or change a payee's bank account, Treasury Online can now confirm that the account is open and that the name matches. Turn it on under Payments > Payee Settings.
- Same-day ACH cutoff extended to 4:45 PM ET.
- Positive Pay exceptions can now be decisioned from the mobile app.

Update your account contacts
Please review the list of authorized users on your account at least once a year and remove anyone who has left your company.

Meridian Commercial Bank | Member FDIC
